PASS on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level); this package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json authored_by is a model, reviewed_by is null), no hardware was attached and no hardware or sim-engine run is claimed. The clone was read-only and is clean at edcc4bf005446839c0c6f43f8a3bf416702af030. Entry symbols were confirmed in the clone: libero/libero/vab/env.py:50 VABEnv, libero/libero/vab/bimanual_env.py:38 VABBimanualEnv, libero/libero/vab/loader.py:11 load_task. Only VABEnv is served; VABBimanualEnv and load_task are not.

DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card's helper is MujocoDriver but its models list is empty, and VABEnv is a robosuite SingleArmEnv that builds its MuJoCo scene at run time (env.py:116-156), not an MJCF file a MujocoDriver could load. The card's decision is already direct-driver, so the package is a direct Driver over libero.vab.env:VABEnv with the package fake; the MujocoDriver helper is not used. This is not a change from the card's decision.

WHAT IS BOUND: cap.world.step.v1 takes ticks and an action object with values, applies the vector at every tick through VABEnv.step and returns observation, reward, terminated, truncated, tick and state_hash. cap.world.reset.v1 takes the integer seed, calls VABEnv.reset(init_index=seed), and echoes the selected initial-state index; the README calls the 50 initial states of a single-arm task seeds and calls reset(init_index=i) (README.md:42-43), so the catalogue seed is mapped to the environment's own initial-state selector. cap.world.seed.v1 is deliberately not bound: VABEnv exposes no random-number-generator seed, only the initial-state selector. The clone states no numeric bound on the control vector (the YAML names the OSC_POSE controller, but its width and per-element ranges belong to robosuite: env.py:282-283), so no Limit and no operator_required bound is declared; the catalogue class's ticks bound (1 to 10000) is enforced by the served schema. No site-limits.example.json is needed and no catalogue_requests are made (only catalogue classes are used).

FAKE AND NOT COVERED: fake.py is a pure Python stand-in for VABEnv, not robosuite or MuJoCo. It was never compared with the upstream environment because robosuite 1.4.0, MuJoCo, numpy and pyyaml were not installed where the gate ran. It keeps a placeholder joint vector, applies a first-order motion, resolves no contact, controller, actuator or free-joint dynamics, and never evaluates the YAML success predicate (success stays False). It returns 2 x 2 x 3 pixel frames per camera while the real task YAMLs set camera_height and camera_width to 128 (README.md:93-94); its proprio arrays use the documented lengths but Python floats instead of float32 numpy arrays. NOT COVERED: the real robosuite/MuJoCo environment and its physics, contacts, controllers and success predicates; the task YAML configuration (no task is loaded); the bimanual VABBimanualEnv and the load_task entry symbol; rendering as a capability (images are carried inside the observation, but cap.world.* binds no render class or artifact store); snapshot/restore (VABEnv exposes no get_state/set_state); the sim backend, which was not run.

WARNINGS kept from the last gate run (both warning-only): G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE because this simulated R0 driver declares no Limit on an actuating capability, so SAFE-014 has nothing to probe (every other CL3 test passed); G8.NO_UNIT for action.values[*] because the clone states no unit for the OSC_POSE control vector and the mixed position/rotation/gripper values cannot be given one honest unit. There were no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. gate.digest is the digest the last check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.

TESTS: test_driver.py keeps the required mhs.testing.check_driver(HERE, backend='fake') call and adds ten cases (strict observation and seed, step advances tick and observation, zero action still advances, seed selects the initial state, class ticks bounds refused, action.values required, reset seed required, out-of-range seed is a failed native call, published fidelity contract, e-stop latch); they pass.
